reason: Free is nice, but Death Note and ORV on a private site with no word on licensing smells like ripped files, and I only read from VIZ, Manga Plus, or J-Novel Club. Plus me and the guys already have Discord plus a reader tab, so there's nothing to switch for.
objection: I don't want to be reading unofficial files, even in a friends-only room — one link leak and it's just a piracy board with a chat box.
would_change_my_mind: If you could show the series are licensed/official sources and the group actually moves over, I'd be in.
